comparisons.reason: Feature 0 requires a comment that explicitly quotes or near-verbatim reproduces a specific factual claim from the OP's title or argument and then refutes it. Opinion or value quotes, unquoted refutations and topic mentions give 0. Feature 1 requires only that any comment directly challenges or argues against the OP's overall stated view. It needs no quote and no factual-claim restriction. Feature 1 is therefore much broader, and a rebuttal without a quote would score 1 on feature 1 and 0 on feature 0. The null rules also differ in detail.
